Overview

Operator (ROOM) is a MythicalMythical unit. He can only be obtained by evolving Operator (Heart).

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Ability: Scramble

Operator (ROOM) has an ability called "Scramble" that teleports enemies back 50% of Lao's Range. This scales with his range, so the more range Operator (ROOM) has, the further back the enemies are teleported. For example, if he has 10 Range, Scramble will teleport enemies 5 'range' backwards on the Path. Scramble works on all enemies in his range, including Bosses.


  • Global Cooldown: 75s
  • This ability wont work on enemies that have already been affected by Scramble 3 times.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
